_comment: AIRLOCK V2 hook config for Codex. Merge the 'hooks' block into ~/.codex/config.toml or place directly in ~/.codex/hooks.json (Codex supports both TOML and JSON hook formats). The script auto-commits dirty work and pushes to a wip/<date>-<agent>-<event-id> branch on every PostToolUse and Stop event. Idempotent and timeout-safe (30s). Conservative: only touches working trees under ~/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/.

hooks.description: Airlock V2: auto-commit + push wip branch after every Codex tool call
Airlock V2: final reconciliation + push on Codex session end

_toml_equivalent:
For ~/.codex/config.toml users, the equivalent blocks are:

[[hooks.post_tool_use]]
matcher = "*"
command = "/Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/_phenofleet-decisions/airlock-v2/hooks/airlock-v2-hook.sh"
description = "Airlock V2: auto-commit + push wip branch after every Codex tool call"
timeout = 30

[[hooks.stop]]
command = "/Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/_phenofleet-decisions/airlock-v2/hooks/airlock-v2-hook.sh"
description = "Airlock V2: final reconciliation + push on Codex session end"
timeout = 30
_trusted_hash_note: If the user has Codex [hooks.state] sha256-trust enabled (per agent-integration survey Section 9.5), add the sha256 of airlock-v2-hook.sh to the trust list before loading this hook config. Compute with: shasum -a 256 /Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/_phenofleet-decisions/airlock-v2/hooks/airlock-v2-hook.sh
